tasks.title: Announcement #60
tasks.instruction: Listen to an announcement at a university club meeting.
tasks.transcript: Welcome everyone. Today we'll be discussing the details for our annual fundraising event. This year we'll be hosting a charity bake sale next Friday in the student center. All proceeds will go to local food banks. We hope you all can participate and make a difference.

questions.stem: What is the main topic of the announcement?

options.D: A change in the club's meeting schedule

questions.analysis: 答案：C 题目问的是：这则公告的主要话题是什么？ 定位原文：Today we'll be discussing the details for our annual fundraising event. This year we'll be hosting a charity bake sale next Friday in the student center. 选项分析： A. A new club member 一名新俱乐部成员。公告中未提及新成员，所以A选项错误。 B. A sporting event 一场体育赛事。公告中未提及体育赛事，所以B选项错误。 C. An upcoming charity event 一场即将到来的慈善活动。公告明确说明年度筹款活动是慈善烘焙义卖，所以C选项正确。 D. A change in the club's meeting schedule 俱乐部会议时间的变更。公告中未提及会议时间变化，所以D选项错误。

questions.stem: What are students encouraged to do?
questions.analysis: 答案：D 题目问的是：鼓励学生们做什么？ 定位原文：We hope you all can participate and make a difference. （结合上文提到的“charity bake sale”） 选项分析： A. Donate food items 捐赠食物。公告中说的是举办烘焙义卖（bake sale），并未明确要求直接捐赠食物，而是希望参与活动，所以A选项不如D准确。 B. Join a club 加入一个俱乐部。公告中未提及招募新成员，所以B选项错误。 C. Visit the Student Center 去学生中心。公告中说活动地点在学生中心，但鼓励的核心是“participate and make a difference”，不仅仅是去学生中心，所以C选项不够完整准确。 D. Participate in a bake sale 参与烘焙义卖。说话者明确希望大家都参与（participate），活动内容是慈善烘焙义卖，所以D选项正确。
